import numpy as np
def score_ruin_nodes(distance_matrix, demands, capacity, route_ids, route_loads, route_dists, removal_savings, stagnation_ratio, iter_frac):
    n = int(np.asarray(route_ids).shape[0])
    if n == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float64)
    dep = np.asarray(distance_matrix[0, 1:], dtype=np.float64)
    dep_scale = max(float(np.mean(dep)), 1e-12)
    dep_hat = np.clip(dep / dep_scale, 0.0, None)
    q = np.asarray(demands[1:], dtype=np.float64)
    q_scale = max(float(np.mean(q)), 1e-12)
    q_hat = np.clip(q / q_scale, 0.0, None)
    cap = max(float(capacity), 1e-12)
    loads = np.asarray(route_loads, dtype=np.float64)
    u = np.clip(loads / cap, 0.0, 1.0)
    rd = np.asarray(route_dists, dtype=np.float64)
    rd_scale = max(float(np.mean(rd)), 1e-12)
    rd_hat = np.clip(rd / rd_scale, 0.0, None)
    rs = np.abs(np.asarray(removal_savings, dtype=np.float64))
    rs_scale = max(float(np.mean(rs)), 1e-12)
    rho = rs / rs_scale
    sr = float(np.clip(stagnation_ratio, 0.0, 1.0))
    fr = float(np.clip(iter_frac, 0.0, 1.0))
    eps = 1e-12
    p_base = 1.10 + 0.60 * fr
    p_sharp = 3.30
    p = p_base + (p_sharp - p_base) * (1.0 - np.power(sr, 0.60))
    exploit = np.power(np.log1p(rho) + eps, p)
    exploit_scale = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(exploit))), 1e-12)
    exploit = exploit / exploit_scale
    divers = (0.55 * np.log1p(dep_hat) + 0.30 * np.log1p(q_hat) + 0.25 * np.log1p(rd_hat))
    divers = divers - 0.35 * np.power(1.0 - u + eps, 0.75)
    d_scale = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(divers))), 1e-12)
    divers = divers / d_scale
    mix = np.power(sr, 0.45)
    score = (1.0 - mix) * exploit + mix * divers
    return np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)

import numpy as np
def score_recreate_action(customer_idx, target_route_idx, insert_delta, regret2_margin, route_load_after, capacity, insert_pos):
    cid = np.asarray(customer_idx, dtype=np.float64)
    n = int(cid.shape[0])
    if n == 0:
        return np.zeros(0, dtype=np.float64)
    cap = max(float(capacity), 1e-12)
    delta = np.asarray(insert_delta, dtype=np.float64)
    reg = np.asarray(regret2_margin, dtype=np.float64)
    load_after = np.asarray(route_load_after, dtype=np.float64)
    pos = np.asarray(insert_pos, dtype=np.float64)
    tr = np.asarray(target_route_idx, dtype=np.float64)
    d_scale = max(float(np.mean(np.abs(delta))), 1e-12)
    detour = -delta / d_scale
    reg_abs = np.abs(reg)
    reg_scale = max(float(np.mean(reg_abs)), 1e-12)
    reg_reward = 1.35 * (reg / reg_scale)
    slack = np.clip(1.0 - load_after / cap, 0.0, 1.0)
    slack_pen = 0.65 * np.power(slack + 1e-12, 1.10)
    new_route_bonus = 0.18 * (tr < 0).astype(np.float64)
    pos_max = float(np.max(pos)) + 1.0
    pos_pen = 0.03 * (pos / pos_max)
    return detour + reg_reward - slack_pen + new_route_bonus - pos_pen
